India-US trade deal negotiations nearing completion, says US envoy

US Ambassador Sergio Gor has stated that significant progress has been made in the trade deal negotiations between India and the United States, with many key issues already addressed. Gor indicated that the talks are nearing their conclusion and highlighted the substantial potential for increased trade between the two nations.
